name: Softech Addons for Elementor
author: shravanchoudhary

sections.description:
Softech Addons for Elementor enhances the Elementor experience with a set of advanced widgets and UI utilities. Whether you’re building complex Loop Grid / Slider , Image Accordion, etc. this plugin makes it all possible.

Pro Version

Want more powerful widgets and premium templates?
Get Softech Addons for Elementor Pro for exclusive features and advanced design tools.

Key Features:

  • Before After Slider
  • Loop Grid slider
  • Image Accordion
  • Testimonial Slider
  • Blob Shapes
  • Number Box
  • Dual Color Heading
  • Call to action
  • PDF Viewer
  • Flip card

Credits

This plugin bundles the Swiper library (https://swiperjs.com/) licensed under the MIT license.

Donations

If you find this plugin useful, consider supporting us via Softechure.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/softech-addons-for-elementor directory, or install it through the WordPress plugin screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to Elementor Editor and explore the new widgets.
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor Pro?

No. Most widgets and features work with the free version of Elementor. However, for theme builder functionality, Elementor Pro is recommended.

Can I use this on a live site?

Yes. It’s production-ready, but always test on a staging environment before deploying new features.

Is this plugin translation-ready?

Yes, the plugin supports translation via the softech-addons-for-elementor text domain.
